objective: Try the authorized independent code-based collaborative proof plus malicious-secure MPC composition without weakening the full PQC-switch requirements.
reference_code_reuse: No unlicensed author proof-core code. Licensed arithmetic and existing official MP-SPDZ are reusable dependencies.

first_run.relation: A small private financial R1CS containing amount-times-price, reservation remainder and bounded integer constraints
first_run.population: One freshly secret-shared valid witness and the same public statement with predeclared tamper mutations
first_run.likely_prediction_error: MPC share-field, tensor-code padding or masking-to-evaluation binding is inconsistent, causing the genuine proof to fail verification
first_run.baseline: The existing classical/hybrid release is retained unchanged; no performance comparison is claimed in this smoke run

hard_boundaries.malicious_mpc: Official MP-SPDZ malicious-shamir, with its field, preprocessing and release/check semantics recorded

required_evidence: contract SHA-256 bound in an experiment manifest before launch
closed result-first plan atomically accepted and launched by the trial runner
exact source, dependency lock, MP-SPDZ artifact and program identities
observed verifier result; no success from compilation, metadata or a signature alone
public proof and a receipt without private inputs, shares or masking randomness
separate report of operational negative tests versus unproved cryptographic composition claims
reject_if: witness reconstruction or centralized reproving replaces collaborative proving
the proof uses elliptic-curve or pairing hardness in PQ mode
the actual selected protocol does not execute
missing or non-finite evidence is treated as success
promotion: This first run can only be smoke_only, rejected or blocked. Production acceptance additionally requires the full financial adapters, authoritative commitments, global on/off state policy, DeFMI verification and real transaction/restart gates; mathematical malicious/PQ composition and parameters must be justified separately.
preflight: The trial runner must validate this contract and its SHA-bound manifest before executing its closed rough command.
postflight: Record public evidence hashes and exactly one verdict in the append-only experiment ledger.
